basic_info.main_problem: Feels that colleagues judge me because I often talk about my dog; I believe they think I am overly obsessed with my pet and hold negative views of me.

core_beliefs: 我是令人反感/怪异的人
我的价值取决于他人对我的看法

special_situations.event: 几个月前without意听到同事对“过度谈论宠物的人”的负面评论
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I talk about my dog at work, I will be considered overly obsessed and strange
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to avoid talking about the pet and steers the conversation back to work topics
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我很烦、我是个怪人

special_situations.event: 办公室谈话中出现宠物或其他个人话题
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果谈及个人兴趣，就会被负面评价，显得not专业
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 迅速Displacement话题或保持沉默，减少参与
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们肯定在心里觉得我烦、觉得我奇怪

special_situations.event: 注意到同事表情或语气not够热情时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果对方看起来not热情，就说明他们在评判我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stops sharing personal content, talks only about facts and work details
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们在暗地里not喜欢我/觉得我很烦

special_situations.event: 准备在工作中分享任何个人内容之前
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose real interests, I will be labeled 'weird' and excluded
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 完全避免自我披露，只围绕工作交流
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 一旦我说起狗，他们就会看轻我

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被同事接纳，能够Freedom分享真实兴趣并被看见与尊重
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判、羞辱与排斥
defense_goal: Lowers the risk of being judged by keeping distance and avoiding personal topics
将话题收窄到工作事项以获得安全感

object_relations.self_representation: 容易被嫌弃、需要小心隐藏自我的人
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、带有negate性的同事群体

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When office conversation turns to pets or other personal topics
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiences colleagues as belittling oneself like past negative commenters (viewing others as critics)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 迅速转回工作议题，use简短、客观的语句；避免自我披露，减少眼神接触。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当觉察到对方表情not够热情或沉默时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets neutral silence/fatigue as belittling and disgust toward oneself
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Reporting work details rationally, avoiding expressing feelings, ending conversations in a flat tone.

Avoids deep contact by minimizing participation and quickly ending conversations
